description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for outputting log data within an application. It implements the LogNode interface to receive log messages, format them, and display them on the UI, also supporting chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting log data and appending it to the UI. Supports chaining with other LogNodes and converts Android log levels into readable strings.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors initializing the LogView with context, optionally with attribute set and style.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including optional exception details, to the LogView UI and passes it to the next LogNode if chained.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string and delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView UI.
